dataDisclosure.note: Citizen observations are synthetic, generated by a documented physical model (see docs/DATA_SOURCES.md). Weather and hydrology are real measurements from Open-Meteo. Site locations are approximate representative points on real watercourses near Coimbra, Portugal. Nothing here describes the measured condition of any real stream.
